scripts.up: docker build -q -t agentgraph-sandbox:local infra/local/sandbox && docker compose -p agentgraph -f infra/local/docker-compose.yml --profile sandbox up -d --wait
scripts.check: oxfmt --check src harnesses agentgraph.config.ts tests bin bench studio tune && oxlint && npm run -s knip && npm run -s check:docs && npm run -s check:hubs && sh bin/precommit.sh && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p studio && vitest run --coverage && npm --prefix studio run -s build
scripts.check:docs: node bin/refs.mjs >/dev/null && node bin/commands.mjs && node bin/fields.mjs && node bin/style.mjs
scripts.check:hubs: for hub in hub/ examples/*/; do [ -e "${hub}hub.yaml" ] || continue; node bin/run.ts check --hub "$hub" || exit 1; done
scripts.format: oxfmt src harnesses agentgraph.config.ts tests bin bench studio tune
